text:
Read web pages and call allowed web services without a browser. Get readable text or make one bounded HTTP request. Start with get and a URL; every destination must satisfy this instance's access rules.
get <url>: Read a page as text or Markdown. Send get with a URL, or a bare URL; JSON format defaults to text. Every redirect uses the configured allowlist; omitted allow permits public addresses only. No JavaScript or subresources run; public-only checks require nodes without DNS64.
  url (string): HTTP(S) URL, at most4096 UTF-8 bytes; default public ports80/443/8080/8443, or a configured exact entry for private/other ports
[destructive] curl <verb> <url> [body...]: Call a web service once and inspect its response. Send curl <VERB> <url> [body...] or JSON; the reply includes a warning, status, repeated headers and the raw body without loss. No CONNECT, retries, insecure TLS or stored credentials are allowed. A sent request may have an unknown outcome.
  verb (string): Case-sensitive ASCII HTTP token, at most32 bytes; CONNECT refused; TRACE and bounded GET/HEAD bodies allowed
  url (string): HTTP(S) URL, at most4096 UTF-8 bytes; each hop must match this instance policy
  body (string): UTF-8 request text, sent unchanged; at most262144 bytes. Omit for empty body

v<version> · PolyForm-NC · parf.dev/agent-bus/
Docs: https://github.com/parf/ai-agent-bus/blob/main/docs/agents/fetch.md
More: agent-bus help <name> config | secret | json

json.author: Serg Parf

get.help: Read a page as text or Markdown. Send get with a URL, or a bare URL; JSON format defaults to text. Every redirect uses the configured allowlist; omitted allow permits public addresses only. No JavaScript or subresources run; public-only checks require nodes without DNS64.

args.name: url
args.help: HTTP(S) URL, at most4096 UTF-8 bytes; default public ports80/443/8080/8443, or a configured exact entry for private/other ports

curl.help: Call a web service once and inspect its response. Send curl <VERB> <url> [body...] or JSON; the reply includes a warning, status, repeated headers and the raw body without loss. No CONNECT, retries, insecure TLS or stored credentials are allowed. A sent request may have an unknown outcome.

args.name: verb
args.help: Case-sensitive ASCII HTTP token, at most32 bytes; CONNECT refused; TRACE and bounded GET/HEAD bodies allowed

args.name: url
args.help: HTTP(S) URL, at most4096 UTF-8 bytes; each hop must match this instance policy

args.name: headers
args.help: JSON only: at most64 headers/16384 bytes; no Host, hop/proxy/framing/Expect or Sec-WebSocket headers

args.name: body_base64
args.help: JSON only: strict base64 for at most262144 raw bytes, mutually exclusive with body

args.name: body
args.help: UTF-8 request text, sent unchanged; at most262144 bytes. Omit for empty body

allow.help: Optional list of at most64 bare hosts or HTTP(S) URL patterns; only * is wildcard. Omitted: public-only; []: deny all. Every request/hop must match. Matching entries without * grant private unicast and all ports in their scope: a bare exact host exposes ALL ports/paths to every ACL grantee; prefer an exact full URL for a narrow grant. Wildcards remain public-only on ports80/443/8080/8443
